// Writes Rust-made backups for the Go port, and verifies a Go-made backup.
//   backupprobe write <outdir>
//   backupprobe verify <backup.zip> <workdir>
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use finglass_core::backup::{BackupService, DB_NAME};
use finglass_core::db::Database;
use finglass_core::model::{AccountType, NewAccount, NewTransaction};
use finglass_core::money::{Currency, Money};
use finglass_core::repo::{accounts, transactions};
use finglass_core::secret::{Passphrase, PassphrasePurpose};
use time::OffsetDateTime;
use time::macros::date;

const PASS: &str = "correct horse battery staple";
const OTHER: &str = "a different backup passphrase";

fn pass(value: &str) -> Passphrase {
    Passphrase::new(value, PassphrasePurpose::New).unwrap()
}

fn fixture(dir: &Path, passphrase: &str) -> Database {
    fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("documents")).unwrap();
    let db = Database::create(&dir.join(DB_NAME), &pass(passphrase)).unwrap();
    let account_id = accounts::create(
        &db,
        NewAccount {
            bank_connection_id: None,
            institution: None,
            name: Some("Probe account".to_owned()),
            iban: None,
            account_number: None,
            currency: Currency::EUR,
            account_type: AccountType::Checking,
            balance: Money { minor: 0, currency: Currency::EUR },
            balance_updated_at: None,
            group_id: None,
        },
    )
    .unwrap();
    for (partner, hash, minor) in [("Bakery", "probe-1", -350), ("Employer", "probe-2", 250_000)] {
        transactions::insert_imported(
            &db,
            account_id,
            vec![NewTransaction {
                booking_date: date!(2026 - 01 - 02),
                amount: Money { minor, currency: Currency::EUR },
                balance_after: None,
                partner_name: Some(partner.to_owned()),
                purpose: None,
                category_id: None,
                import_hash: hash.to_owned(),
                created_at: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(),
                is_new: false,
                tax_override: None,
            }],
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    fs::write(dir.join("documents").join("a-receipt.txt"), b"receipt text\n").unwrap();
    fs::write(dir.join("documents").join("b-scan.pdf"), b"%PDF-1.7 probe\n").unwrap();
    db
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    match args[1].as_str() {
        "write" => {
            let out = PathBuf::from(&args[2]);
            for (name, passphrase) in [("rust-backup.zip", PASS), ("rust-backup-other-passphrase.zip", OTHER)] {
                let work = out.join(format!("work-{name}"));
                let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&work);
                let db = fixture(&work, passphrase);
                let info = BackupService::new(work.clone()).create_backup(&db, &out.join(name)).unwrap();
                println!("{name}: {info:?}");
                drop(db);
                fs::remove_dir_all(&work).unwrap();
            }
        }
        "verify" => {
            let backup = PathBuf::from(&args[2]);
            let work = PathBuf::from(&args[3]).join("data");
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&work);
            fs::create_dir_all(&work).unwrap();
            let db = Database::create(&work.join(DB_NAME), &pass(PASS)).unwrap();
            let service = BackupService::new(work.clone());
            println!("inspect: {:?}", service.inspect(&backup).unwrap());
            service.stage_restore(&db, &backup, None).unwrap();
            drop(db);
            service.apply_pending_restore(OffsetDateTime::now_utc()).unwrap().unwrap();
            let db = Database::open(&work.join(DB_NAME), &pass(PASS)).unwrap();
            let names = db
                .with_conn(|conn| {
                    let mut st = conn.prepare("SELECT partner_name FROM transactions ORDER BY id")?;
                    let rows = st.query_map([], |row| row.get::<_, Option<String>>(0))?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
                    Ok(rows)
                })
                .unwrap();
            println!("partners: {names:?}");
            let mut docs: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(work.join("documents"))
                .unwrap()
                .map(|e| e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
                .collect();
            docs.sort();
            println!("documents: {docs:?}");
            println!("VERIFY OK");
        }
        _ => panic!("usage"),
    }
}
